0022600121.text: The Bulls (1-2, 11th in the East and 4th in the Central, 1.5 games back) visit the Boston Celtics (1-1, 8th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back) for Chicago's fourth game of the season, after the Bulls have lost their last game and the Celtics have won theirs. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, while Noa Essengue (head bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bulls lost 1-2 to Boston in 2025-26, including a 124-105 loss in Boston on February 11, 2026.
